title: populus × canadensis var. carolinensis
intro: Populus × canadensis var. carolinensis, commonly known as Black Cottonwood or Carolina Poplar, is a deciduous tree species native to eastern North America. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, sore throats, and respiratory problems, due to its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Populus × canadensis var. carolinensis include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help to alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections and promote healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include salicylic acid, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
